apps.localizedDescription:
Alien Shooter 2 (Alien Shooter - Vengeance) is a large-scale sequel to the first part of Alien Shooter. This is the unique alloy of arcade action and RPG elements which combines well-established world of classical games and unmatched dynamics of the first part.

The ENHANCED version of the legendary top-down PC Alien Shooter 2 game is now available on your iOS device!

Deserted military complex. Hordes of merciless creatures. You. 
Your mission is simple – clear the base and stop the alien invasion.

---------------------------------------------------
- No in-game purchases and persuasive ads!
- Hours of gameplay with and engaging story mode and tons
